facts.text: Piper, the only member of the team who reads the briefing
facts.why: The Colonel calls Piper one of the best men he has, but no scene shows Piper reading a briefing the others skip.
facts.fix: Piper, one of the best men the Colonel has got

facts.text: Rigged up from whatever was in Vicki's fridge.
facts.why: Vicki takes MacGruber to her house to remove the bullet from his leg. No fridge scene shows in the plot or transcript.
facts.fix: Rigged up at Vicki's after she patches his leg.

facts.text: Piper's order, while MacGruber hides the celery.
facts.why: Piper and MacGruber have beers outside the trailer, not ginger beer. The celery is MacGruber's distraction scene, he is not hiding it.
facts.fix: Piper's order, beers outside MacGruber's trailer.

facts.why: The transcript has the car stereo gag at the party ("Your car stereo? Nice try.") but no mission briefing involves it.
